title: 第二章都别闲着
slug: 我在诡异入侵世界当农场主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这里还真是个戒网瘾的好地方，根本用不了任何电子产品，嘿嘿嘿。”

一边努力干活顺便偷听的牛心想：完了，人疯了！

苏妗月下着单，“我真的是疯了，居然开始比较面包和泡面谁更有营养。”

“种子，这可是安身立命的根本，只是之前也没有种过，不知道能不能种出来。”

“你怎么不直接抢钱啊？这么贵，肯定包活、包真吧。”

尽管骂骂咧咧，但是种子最后还是进了购物车。

等等，为什么要自己种？我花钱买，然后在这边高价卖不也能赚差价嘛，而且还不用自己动手，我简直就是个天才。

苏妗月为自己的聪明而感到惊叹，直拍自己大腿。

啪啪的声音听着老牛抖了两下耳朵，吃草的速度更快了，打了自己就不能打我了哈。

“现在钱不多，先买点东西试试，买啥呢，买一箱黄瓜吧，这东西，卖不出去还能自己吃，价格也不贵。”

还差什么现在暂时也想不到了，苏妗月准备先下单，能来多少算多少，看了看，就这点东西，每个看起来都不贵，但是加在一起还真不便宜，738.66就出去了，怪不得大家都说穷呢，原来钱都是这样出去的。

“牛哥，我下单了快递，这个它送到哪里啊，我去拿。”

苏妗月站起来四处张望，就这么大点地方，不能给她送到另一个山头吧。

“哞。”

雄厚的声音响起，苏妗月下意识回头一看，就看见老牛哒哒哒地就要往农场门口走。

“等等，我才刚下单，商家应该还没有发货，我只是说一声，今天还不一定能到......呢。”

苏妗月呆呆地站在原地，看着在院子里面慢悠悠的老牛，出了院门跟开了马达一样，一转眼就不见了，只留下飞起的尘烟证明她刚刚看见的一切都是真的。

“不是，牛哥，你去了干啥啊，万一还没到呢，你等我先看一下！”

撕心裂肺的冲着消失的老牛吼完，回应她的只有尘土，已签收的状态。

“这么快啊。”

等待期间，苏妗月没事儿干，自己也不敢出去，就开始研究天赋。

就在苏妗月放空大脑的时候，远处再次冒起一个尘烟，尘烟之中，一个高大伟岸的身影正带着满满当当的包裹朝着小院的方向奔驰而来，然后在小院门口刹住，将身上的包裹丢在地上。

苏妗月走到老牛身边，先是好奇的看了一眼老牛身上，再看看地上的包裹，“牛哥，你身上有吸铁石吗？都没有绳子绑在一起，你是怎么把它们带回来的？”

“哞。”

“真神奇啊。”

苏妗月也没真指望老牛回答，感叹两声就开始拆包裹。

“牛哥。”

“哞。”

“我打不开......”

“哞哞。”

"This is really a good place to get rid of Internet addiction. You can't use any electronic products at all, hehehe."

Niu, who was eavesdropping while working hard, thought: It's over, people are crazy!

Su Jinyue placed her order, "I'm really crazy. I started comparing bread and instant noodles to see who is more nutritious."

"Seeds, they are the foundation for a life and a good life, but I have never planted them before, so I don't know if they can be planted."

"Why don't you just grab the money? It's so expensive, so it must be done live and honestly."

Despite the cursing, the seeds finally went into the shopping cart.

Wait, why grow your own?If I buy it with money and then sell it here at a high price, I can make a profit on the difference, and I don’t have to do it myself. I’m simply a genius.

Su Jinyue was amazed at her own cleverness and slapped her thigh.

Hearing the snapping sound, the old cow twitched its ears twice and ate grass faster. If you hit yourself, you can't hit me anymore.

"We don't have much money now, so let's buy something to try first. What should I buy? Let's buy a box of cucumbers. If you can't sell these things, you can still eat them yourself. The price is not expensive."

Now I can't think of anything else. Su Jinyue is going to place an order first, taking whatever she can get. After looking at these items, each of them seems cheap, but together they are really not cheap. It cost 738.66. No wonder everyone says they are poor. It turns out that this is how money goes out.

"Brother Niu, I placed an order for express delivery. Where will it be delivered? I'll go get it."

Su Jinyue stood up and looked around. It was such a big place, so she couldn't be sent to another hilltop.

"Moo."

A strong voice sounded, and Su Jinyue subconsciously looked back and saw the old cow clattering towards the farm gate.

"Wait a minute, I just placed the order, and the merchant shouldn't have shipped it yet. I just wanted to say that it may not arrive today..."

Su Jinyue stood there blankly, looking at the old cow walking slowly in the yard. When he left the yard, it was like turning on the motor. He disappeared in the blink of an eye, leaving only the flying dust and smoke to prove that everything she just saw was true.

"No, Brother Niu, what are you doing there? If you haven't arrived yet, please wait and let me take a look first!"

After roaring heart-wrenchingly at the disappearing old cow, all she received in response was dust and a signed receipt.

"So fast."

While waiting, Su Jinyue had nothing to do, and she didn't dare to go out, so she started studying her talent.

Just when Su Jinyue was emptying her mind, a cloud of dust and smoke appeared in the distance again. In the dust and smoke, a tall and majestic figure was running towards the small courtyard with a full package. Then he stopped at the door of the small courtyard and threw the package on the ground.

Su Jinyue walked to Lao Niu and looked at Lao Niu curiously, then at the package on the ground, "Brother Niu, do you have any magnets on you? There is no rope to tie them together. How did you bring them back?"

"Moo."

"It's amazing."

Su Jinyue didn't really expect Lao Niu to answer, so she sighed twice and started to unpack the package.

"Brother Niu."

"Moo."

"I can't open..."

"Moo."

Brother Niu had no choice but to come over and pull with his horns, and the carton was removed.
